title: Core Quartet #32
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, four women in a single row.

A photograph of FOUR women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, generous horizontal spacing between each so every figure reads clearly and large within the frame, the camera set back so all 4 fit comfortably within the frame from head to toe, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Far-left woman: a real adult Spanish woman in her late 50s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, dramatic winged liner, a deep red lip, a passionate expression, warm olive skin, sultry, wavy hair, real living eyes. Long stiletto nails, holographic finish.

Far-left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. an extraordinarily tall and enormous woman, far beyond any real person, towering and broad. A commanding, statuesque frame with huge broad shoulders, powerful thick arms with hard defined muscle, a strong deep chest, and a long, dense, muscular torso with only a slight inward taper at the waist. Enormous powerful hips and colossal long thighs with hard muscle visible through a soft layer, thick strong calves. Not slim, not delicate, powerful, statuesque and imposing. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Far-left woman's body art: painted in Finnish Iittala glass-inspired linework — a deep indigo ground with bold cream concentric ripple-line motifs, wide cream bands following every deep crease, dense concentric ripple linework filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Far-left woman's pose: kneeling on one knee, the other raised.

Far-left woman's footwear: extreme cream ballet heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Left woman: a real adult Russian woman in her mid 50s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, very fair, cool skin, sculpted feathered dark brows, a precise winged liner, soft taupe eyeshadow, long lashes, large pale eyes with bright real catchlights, strong contour and a bright highlighter along the cheekbones and nose bridge, glossy nude-pink lips, long straight platinum-blonde hair, a cold, striking expression, bold and confident, curly hair, real living eyes. Long coffin nails, glittery finish.

Left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. An immense mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle, sagging down toward her knees under its own weight, gathering into three or four heavy rounded folds stacked one above the other, deep shadowed creases between them, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. A gigantic bust resting on the top fold, no waist at all, colossal hips more than three times the width of her shoulders, each thigh thicker than a normal woman's waist, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: painted in Vasarely-inspired optical-illusion pattern — a repeating grid of squares bulging in a 3D illusion, wide silver bands following every deep crease, dense optical illusion grid filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Left woman's pose: kneeling on both knees, facing camera.

Left woman's footwear: extreme silver sculptural heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Right woman: a real adult Egyptian woman in her mid 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, warm golden-bronze skin, sharp winged kohl liner, a deep terracotta-red lip, demure and soft, high ponytail hair, real living eyes. Long round nails, matte finish.

Right woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. An immense mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle, sagging down toward her knees under its own weight, gathering into three or four heavy rounded folds stacked one above the other, deep shadowed creases between them, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. A gigantic bust resting on the top fold, no waist at all, colossal hips more than three times the width of her shoulders, each thigh thicker than a normal woman's waist, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Right woman's body art: painted in Finnish Iittala glass-inspired linework — a deep indigo ground with bold cream concentric ripple-line motifs, wide cream bands following every deep crease, dense concentric ripple linework filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Right woman's pose: back fully to camera.

Right woman's footwear: extreme cream platform stiletto knee-high boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Far-right woman: a real adult Spanish woman in her mid 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, dramatic winged liner, a deep red lip, a passionate expression, warm olive skin, cheerful, twin-tail hair, real living eyes. Long square nails, glossy finish.

Far-right woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. A dramatically impossible waist-to-hip ratio dominates her silhouette: a colossal heavy bust, an extremely sharply cinched waist pulled in far tighter than the waistline of any of her other curves, and then enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than that narrow waist. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a gigantic rounded rear. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Far-right woman's body art: painted in Georgian minonkari cloisonné enamel — a deep black ground with fine gold cloisonné wirework, wide gold bands following every deep crease, dense cloisonné floral wirework filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Far-right woman's pose: seated on a low stool, hands on knees.

Far-right woman's footwear: extreme gold platform stiletto peep-toe heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly.

Skin (all): real photographic skin, visible pores and fine grain, natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds, no illustration finish, no CG sheen.

Lighting: the hard raking light carving every fold and curve on all 4, catching each woman's own painted pattern distinctly. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 4:5 landscape 8K.
